concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading/parsing real datasets from NCBI GEO/Zenodo. Tasks T009.1 and T043 only address this as a 'stub' or 'revision' item. There is no primary task to implement the full Real Adapter logic required to satisfy FR-001's core mandate of fetching real data.

FR-012 requires mapping raw metabolite names to KEGG Compound IDs before pathway alignment. Task T019.2 (moved to T045) is listed as a 'Revision' item dependent on a local static file not yet created. No primary task exists to generate or implement this critical mapping step in the main flow.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T007 vs spec.md:FR-003 & Constitution Principle III
concerns.text: FR-003 and Constitution Principle III require rejecting datasets with >10% missing values and checksumming raw data. Task T007 (Synthetic Generator) produces data with 'embedded ground truth' but lacks a specific task to simulate the >10% missing value rejection logic or the checksumming of external raw sources, leaving these requirements untested.

FR-010 requires Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO) validation using multiple independent external datasets. Tasks T009.1 and T009.3 only implement a 'Synthetic Multi-Dataset Generator' and a stub 'ExternalDatasetManager'. No task exists to fetch/ingest multiple distinct real-world datasets required for a genuine LODO test.

The plan defines project structure and schema files (contracts/) as Phase 1/2 deliverables. Tasks T001 (project structure) and T004 (schemas) are marked as 'rejected' or 'unverifiable' with no completed artifacts, leaving foundational data contracts undefined and blocking FR-001, FR-002, and FR-009 implementation.

Task T021 is marked 'SKIPPED' due to a YAML+regex parse failure in the task description itself. The description contains malformed YAML/Markdown that prevents parsing, requiring a fix to the task text to enable execution.
